data.name: Elyndor Quest
data.detailed_description:
Elevador Quest is a single-player fantasy RPG set in a universe divided between the planets Feremor and Elyndor, where ancient rivalries, wars between kingdoms, and primordial entities threaten the existence of both worlds.

Choose between two completely different journeys.

As an Orc, your journey begins in a hidden refuge deep within the lands of Feremor. Unite fractured clans, reclaim ancient strongholds, confront rival warlords, and uncover the cosmic forces manipulating every race in a conflict that could change the fate of two worlds.

As a Human, your adventure begins with a quest for revenge after the murder of your parents. However, you soon uncover a world torn apart by political struggles, religious conflicts, necromancers, and ancient cults, while an even greater threat rises in the shadows. Your choices may determine the future of Elyndor and decide whether both worlds survive.

Travel through cities, fortresses, caves, ancient ruins, forests, deserts, and dangerous dungeons. Fight orcs, goblins, trolls, ogres, undead, and other supernatural creatures, uncover legendary artifacts, and reveal the secrets behind the gods and ancient beings manipulating the fate of both planets.

Every region features its own culture, factions, political conflicts, and memorable characters. Complete main and side quests, develop your character, acquire powerful equipment, and make decisions that will shape the war between Feremor and Elyndor.

Features

- Play as either an Orc or a Human, each with a unique storyline.

- Explore two planets filled with unique cultures, creatures, and history.

- Battle epic bosses and a wide variety of enemies.

- Experience a rich story of war, ancient gods, and hidden conspiracies.

- Complete both main and side quests.

- Upgrade your character with new equipment and abilities.

- Explore a vast third-person medieval fantasy world.

- Discover hidden treasures, legendary artifacts, and secret locations.

- Make choices that influence characters, factions, and the fate of both planets.

The war between Feremor and Elyndor has only just begun. The fate of two worlds will be decided by the choices you make throughout your journey.

data.short_description: Explore a single-player medieval fantasy RPG set on the continents of Feremor and Elyndor. Play as an Orc seeking freedom for your people or as a Human driven by vengeance. Confront wars, dark creatures, and choices that will define the fate of two civilizations.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 8100t
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 550 4 GB
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K | Amd Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
